acceptance_criteria:
- Script generates every production secret on the target host and writes them only to the app's env file
- docs/runbook/secrets.md explains recovery and rotation
- Rehearsed on staging
description: Agent part of p10-secrets (jade-8n2.6). A script that generates CODE_PEPPER, SESSION_SECRET and the backup encryption key on the server without printing them to logs, and docs/runbook/secrets.md covering storage, recovery and rotation. Rehearsed on staging.
title: Script production secret generation and write the secrets runbook
